mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns is negative and significant (p<0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which leads to reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between UNRATE and 5d returns is positive and significant (p<0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a deepening economic contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: When UNRATE rises > 0.1pp and INDPRO falls > 0.5% in 1 month, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative and not significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained), the Federal Reserve's policy shift toward higher rates compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns in tightening cycles is positive and significant (p<0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST is above 500, the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between HOUST and 5d returns is negative and significant (p<0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in manufacturing output, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 90.0, the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between INDPRO and 60d returns is positive and significant (p<0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, which leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS rises > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: When RSAFS rises > 0.5% and HOUST rises > 0.5% in 1 month, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is negative and not significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 8.0%), a decline in employment (PAYEMS) signals worsening labor market conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS declines > 0.5% in 1 month, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC between the PAYEMS decline and 5d returns in high-unemployment regimes is positive and significant (p<0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.
